verse.verse_1: By the Fig and the Olive,
verse.verse_4: We have indeed created man in the best of mould,
verse.verse_5: then We cast him down as the lowest of the low,
verse.verse_6: except for those who believe and do good deeds -- theirs shall be an unending reward!
verse.verse_7: What then after this, can make you deny the Last Judgement?
verse.verse_8: Is not God the greatest of the judges?
